primitives.name: Dual Free Score Chain
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Dual free score chains | Sport | Primary | Failover | |-------|---------|----------| | ncaaf/ncaab |
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{sport}': 'Score vector for sport, dimensionless', 'P_{sport}': 'Primary source identifier, categorical', 'F_{sport}': 'Failover source identifier, categorical'}
primitives.assumptions: Each sport has deterministic primary and failover data sources; score vectors are independent across sources.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When both P and F return null or error, S_{sport} is undefined.

layer2.mapping: Free score chain maps to a binary decision tree with probabilistic branching based on source availability and accuracy.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage gap percentage per sport computed via `redundancyGaps(2)`.

primitives.name: Free Odds Dual Market
primitives.verbatim_quote: | ## Free odds dual Polymarket Gamma + Kalshi public (no Odds key required). ## Operator
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'O_{sport}^{free}': 'Free odds vector for sport, dimensionless', 'M_{1}, M_{2}': 'Market identifiers (Polymarket, Kalshi), categorical'}
primitives.assumptions: Both markets provide independent, non-key-restricted odds; they are statistically independent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When both M_1 and M_2 are unavailable, O_{sport}^{free} is undefined.

layer2.mapping: Free odds dual is derived from two independent market kernels; used in GSI for risk-neutral probability estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Market overlap ratio and variance between M_1 and M_2.

primitives.name: Redundancy Gap Matrix
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Operator surface - `GET /api/cockpit/world-class-readiness` (admin) - `freeCoverageMatrix()` / `redundancyGaps(2)` - `/cockpit/sources` ## Agents / media / engines Draft-ready only.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G_{ij}': 'Gap indicator between source i and j, dimensionless', 'C_{sport}': 'Coverage matrix for sport, size N x N'}
primitives.assumptions: Gaps are binary indicators; C_{sport} is symmetric and positive semi-definite.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When G_{ij} = 1 for all i,j, coverage is minimal.

layer2.mapping: Coverage gap matrix is derived from source availability logs; used in GSE for dynamic routing.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of redundant paths available per sport computed by `freeCoverageMatrix()`.
